body_markdown:
*Braze has been named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Cross-Channel Marketing Hubs, Q4 2026. This assessment looked at a range of different customer engagement platforms and cross-channel marketing hubs and reviewed them on their strategy and execution capabilities. We believe this placement reflects the Braze platform’s ability to support exceptional marketing experiences across channels, as well as our ongoing work to amplify the impact of marketing teams and to drive innovation in the customer engagement space.*


***Key takeaways***


- *Braze was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Cross-Channel Marketing Hubs, Q4 2026, including recognition as a vendor with “above average customer feedback”*
- *Braze achieved the highest score in the Strategy criteria among all evaluated vendors, and also achieved the highest score possible in nine criteria: Vision, Innovation, Roadmap, Community, Partner Ecosystem, Content and Experience Design, Experience Optimization, Offer and Promotion Management, and Mobile*
- *Previously, Braze was recognized as a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Multichannel Marketing Hubs and Magic Quadrant for Email Marketing Platforms reports*


*View a complimentary copy of the CCMH Wave report[here](https://www.braze.com/resources/reports-and-guides/forrester-wave-ccmh-2026) for more information.*


Consumers increasingly engage with brands across a variety of platforms, devices, and other touchpoints, and they expect each interaction to deliver what they need in that moment. Marketers need to be able to engage their customers with the right message across channels to build long-term loyalty and stronger business outcomes.


Many brands still struggle to deliver connected experiences because their tools and data are siloed. To succeed, marketers need a customer engagement solution built to solve the challenges of today and lead the innovations of the future.


Against this backdrop, Braze was recently named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Cross-Channel Marketing Hubs, Q4 2026. Braze achieved the highest score in the Strategy category among all evaluated vendors, and also received the highest possible score in nine of the assessment’s criteria: Vision, Innovation, Roadmap, Community, Partner Ecosystem, Content and Experience Design, Experience Optimization, Offer and Promotion Management, and Mobile.


Forrester writes that the Braze platform’s “AI innovation, pragmatic roadmap, and active user community position Braze for enterprise expansion beyond its global digital-first base.” In addition, Forrester said: “Braze’s customers praise its usability, innovation, and responsive partnership approach in supporting complex deployments.” The report also recognizes Braze as a vendor with “above-average customer feedback.”


We believe this placement reflects our platform’s ability to create compelling customer experiences across channels while allowing marketers to benefit from streaming data, AI decisioning, and advanced personalization in a single, composable solution.


## **What being a Forrester Wave Leader means for Braze customers**


At Braze, we believe the highly personalized, responsive experiences that brands like[Panera Bread](https://www.braze.com/customers/panera-case-study) ,[e.l.f. Beauty](https://www.braze.com/customers/elf-case-study) , and[Kayo Sports](https://www.braze.com/customers/kayo-sports-case-study) create across channels highlight the value and impact of the Braze platform for brands and consumers alike. These brands used Braze to meet customers in the moments that matter, and the business results followed:


- **Panera Bread:** To keep guests engaged through its largest menu transformation, Panera orchestrated a cross-channel journey across email, push, in-app messages, and Content Cards, connected to its AI-powered decision engine. This resulted in a 5% retention lift among at-risk guests and 2X loyalty offer redemptions.
- **e.l.f. Beauty:** To deepen engagement with its Beauty Squad loyalty program, e.l.f. expanded into push, SMS, in-app messages, and Content Cards. Monthly app usage rose 125% over six months, and loyalty offer redemptions increased 58% year over year.
- **Kayo Sports:** To improve customer retention, Kayo Sports used BrazeAI Decisioning Studio™ Pro to personalize messages for each individual subscriber, choosing the message, offer, channel, and timing for each customer across email, SMS, push, and in-app messages. The program drove a 14% increase in subscriptions and 105% increase in cross-selling.


These brands delivered meaningful cross-channel experiences across a wide range of different industries, regions, and business models, showcasing the flexibility of the Braze platform and its ability to elevate customer engagement programs of all shapes and sizes.


## **How Braze helps brands drive value**


Reaching your audience on the right channels is critical to any customer engagement strategy. But these channels can’t reach their full potential if your customer engagement program and your marketing technology stack aren’t built on a strong foundation.


Data is at the core of any customer engagement program. Without accurate, real-time context, every message risks feeling irrelevant and losing the audience’s attention or loyalty. That’s why we built Braze on a[stream processing architecture](https://www.braze.com/resources/articles/ultimate-guide-to-data-streaming-technologies) that makes it possible to act on data as soon as it comes in, and why we developed[Canvas](https://www.braze.com/docs/user_guide/messaging/canvas) , which orchestrates responsive journeys at scale across outbound, inbound, digital, and offline surfaces.


That data also has to flow across the rest of your marketing tech stack. The[Braze Data Platform](https://www.braze.com/resources/articles/braze-data-platform-announcement) (BDP) is a composable data solution that helps customers unify data from the sources they already use, activate it across Braze, and then distribute engagement data to data warehouses, CDPs, analytics tools, AdTech platforms, and more using APIs, SDKs, Braze[Cloud Data Ingestion](https://www.braze.com/docs/user_guide/data/unification/cloud_ingestion) (CDI), Zero-Copy Triggers, and Data Transformation. In this way, the BDP serves as a first-party context engineering layer for AI.


On top of that foundation, BrazeAI™ gives marketers multiple new capabilities, so they can match the right AI tool to each use case in order to support better customer experiences.[BrazeAI Decisioning Studio™ Pro](https://www.braze.com/docs/user_guide/brazeai/decisioning_studio) uses AI decisioning agents to make per-customer decisions for all aspects of a marketing journey,[BrazeAI Decisioning Studio™ Go](https://www.braze.com/docs/user_guide/brazeai/decisioning_studio_go) brings 1:1 decisioning to every customer journey, and[BrazeAI Agent Console™](https://www.braze.com/resources/articles/brazeai-agent-console-product-spotlight) lets marketers build agents that automate key aspects of the customer engagement process. These products are reshaping what’s possible for marketers when creating exceptional personalized experiences at speed and scale on every channel and across every touchpoint.


When brands invest in the right tools and build a solid foundation for customer engagement, the impact can be significant. To help assess the potential return on investment and business impact associated with using Braze, we commissioned Forrester Consulting to conduct a[Total Economic Impactᵀᴹ (TEI) of Braze study](https://www.braze.com/resources/articles/2026-forrester-tei-of-braze) . The study found that a composite organization using Braze achieved a 457% return on investment over three years, $23.5 million in net present value, and payback period of less than six months, which we believe showcases the meaningful benefits that can result from using the tools and capabilities that our platform provides.


## **How Braze is demonstrating true market leadership**


Braze is committed to building a truly flexible, multi-faceted customer engagement platform that serves brands of every size, region, and industry. Achieving that goal means simultaneously thinking broadly about what marketers need, while also going deep on the capabilities that matter most, a balance we believe is reflected in the results of two recent reports from industry analyst firm Gartner.


Earlier this year, Gartner named Braze a Leader in the[2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Multichannel Marketing Hubs](https://www.braze.com/resources/articles/braze-named-leader-2026-gartner-magic-quadrant) (MMH). Braze was positioned highest among evaluated vendors in Ability to Execute and the furthest in Completeness of Vision, and Braze was ranked first in the Multichannel Engagement (3.59/5) and Omnichannel Workflow Innovation (3.50/5) Use Cases in the Gartner Critical Capabilities for Multichannel Marketing Hubs report. Because the assessment looks at the full scope of customer engagement capabilities related to Multichannel Marketing Hubs, we believe it highlights the full scope of what Braze has to offer, including our platform’s capabilities around AI, personalization, and data management.


Gartner also named Braze a Leader in the inaugural[Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Email Marketing Platforms](https://www.braze.com/resources/articles/braze-named-leader-2026-gartner-email-magic-quadrant) , which focused on depth in the single, critical channel of email. Braze was ranked first in all of the email marketing use cases that Gartner assessed in the Critical Capabilities for Email Marketing Platforms report, including promotional messaging (4.34/5), triggered messaging (4.38/5), and post-purchase messaging (4.38/5). Because email remains among the most widely used and impactful digital messaging channels, we believe this recognition complements the Multichannel Marketing Hubs report, demonstrating the depth and breadth of what Braze can do to enable best-in-class customer engagement.


## **Final thoughts**


Tomorrow’s best campaigns will be cross channel in nature, powered by AI decisioning and autonomous agents that continuously learn what each customer needs and adapts accordingly to deliver compelling experiences. The Braze platform is designed to help marketers create those individualized, responsive experiences at scale, and to help marketers stay ahead of the curve as innovation continues in the AI space and beyond.


Looking to dig deeper? View a[complimentary copy of the Forrester Wave report](https://www.braze.com/resources/reports-and-guides/forrester-wave-ccmh-2026) to learn more about the Braze platform, among other provider offerings.
